format: One closed canonical JSON archive with a typed metadata skeleton and flat SHA256-keyed rectangular numeric component table. Only arrays with at least8 scalars become deduplicated components.
identity: Caller must provide trusted original checkpoint, model-state and implementation SHA256 identities; archive raw identity is also required on unpack. Exact canonical checkpoint bytes are restored; nested lineage is preserved in the reconstructed bytes.
next_guarded_qualification: Pin a separate zero-update conversion plan or an explicitly reviewed post-run serialization step; exact N10/N11/N12 canonical byte equality and real size counts before advertising usable archived checkpoints.
storage: No float32 conversion or compression. Signed zero and integer/float JSON distinctions retained. No actual size-savings claim before guarded actual roundtrip.
